Aïcha Ben Salah
Berlin (relocated 2025)

Professional summary:
Registered nurse with 7 years' clinical experience in Tunisia. Currently on §16d AufenthG for the recognition of foreign qualifications (Anerkennungsverfahren). Strong geriatric-care background; documentation, medication administration, multidisciplinary handover.

Experience:
- Hôpital Habib Bourguiba, Tunis — Krankenpflegerin, 2018-2025 (7 years). Geriatric ward 2 years; general medical ward 5 years. Shifts of up to 12 residents per shift, full documentation in Arabic + French.
- Internship — Clinique La Soukra, Tunis, 2017-2018. Surgical recovery.

Languages:
- Arabic — native
- French — C1
- English — B2 (Cambridge BEC Vantage 2019)
- German — B1 (telc B1 Pflege, currently studying toward B2)

Residency / authorisation:
- §16d AufenthG visa (issued 2025-02; for recognition of foreign qualification)
- Recognition decision letter expected from BIBB / Anabin in ~4 months

Availability: full-time, can start onboarding immediately at an Anerkennung-friendly employer.
